settings.text: Pick a topic. If your question is not here, write to me.

settings.question: When will my print arrive?
settings.answer: Prints and paper goods leave the studio within three working days, packed flat or rolled in a tube, with tracking. Most parcels arrive within a week.

settings.question: Do you ship abroad?
settings.answer: Yes, to most countries. The delivery price for yours is shown at checkout before you pay. Downloads and the course work anywhere.

settings.question: How are prints packed?
settings.answer: Small prints go flat between card. Large prints are rolled in a tube with tissue. Totes and sketch pads go in a paper mailer.

settings.question: How do I get a download?
settings.answer: Brushes, wallpapers and other files arrive as a download link by email the moment you pay. The link stays in your account, so you can download again on a new device.

settings.question: Which apps do the brushes work in?
settings.answer: Procreate on iPad. Each set says which version it needs on its page.

settings.question: Can I use the files for my own work?
settings.answer: Yes, for anything you make and sell yourself. You cannot resell or share the files as they are.

settings.question: How long can I watch the course?
settings.answer: The course is yours once you pay: every lesson, as often as you like, including lessons added later.

settings.question: What do I need to start?
settings.answer: A lino block, a cutting tool, a roller, block printing ink and paper. The first lesson lists all of it, with prices.

settings.question: Can I return something?
settings.answer: Send a print or paper item back unused within 30 days for a full refund. Downloads and the course can be refunded within 14 days if you have not opened them.

settings.question: My print arrived damaged
settings.answer: Send a photo with your order number and I will print and send a new one.
